exposure: Primary surgeon specialization (gynaecological oncologists vs. experienced obstetricians)
outcome: Number of units of blood transfused
cohort: 88 patients with suspected or confirmed placenta accreta spectrum disorder (PASD)
finding: Although hysterectomy rates were significantly reduced, no statistically significant difference was found in estimated blood loss between cases of placenta accreta spectrum disorder managed by experienced obstetricians compared to those managed with the presence of gynaecological oncologists.
